comments.text:
We wrote a historical novel set in the period BEFORE the canal. Teddy Roosevelt decreed 'not one spade of dirt could be dug before the canal was dug.  People took the twelve thousand trip rather than take a train trip across the ithmus. As you reported the French who dug the Suez canal thought Panama (Half as long) would be simple. Panama was the most dangerous place on earth. Yellow fever and Malaria killed thousands of the French teams. Our book takes place before the canal builders arrived.

Some of the stories are insane. The French brought over a convent of nursing nuns who - to prevent ants crawling on patients - put pans of water under the legs of the beds. Pretty much everyone died as the pans bred mosquitos to perfection.

Dr GORGAS and made the US effort possible as they pointed out that filth and rats and everything else Didn't Cause Yellow Fever! Swamps had to be drained - sitting water removed. 

Years earlier soldiers returning to the US who had SURVIVED Yellow Fever were locked up at Fort Wycoff (I found this in a 1907 encyclopedia) out of fear of the disease.
